relevance_note: A narrative 'How I Treat' review that reports HA20 features only as aggregate percentages from earlier reviews and cohorts ("Table 1 summarizes reported disease features using data from three published reviews"); it describes no identifiable individual with a TNFAIP3 variant.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; no script transcribed any table. Table 1 (phenotype frequencies) and Supplementary Table 1 (treatment frequencies) give only percentages or counts per published series, with no individual-level rows. The only single-patient mention is in Treatment of HA20: "In one severe and refractory case, we have referred a patient for allogeneic stem cell transplantation, who has been in drug-free remission for over 2 years after transplant." This gives no sex, age, variant or clinical feature, and does not state the patient's TNFAIP3 variant, so I judged it not an identifiable in-scope individual and created no row. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated are null: the paper describes no patients of its own; the ~200 reported cases worldwide and the 185-case multicenter cohort (ref 22) are other publications' counts. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null because the paper has no patients of its own to re-report. Contradictions noticed: the Table 1 header cites the multicenter cohort as reference (27), but the text cites it as (22), and reference 27 is He et al. 2020. Supplementary Table 1 gives Karri 2024 n = 189, while Table 1 gives 199 patients for Karri et al. 2024.

study_type.span: this review aims to highlight key principles in our approach to patients with known or suspected HA20
